product.title: Explore Olympic National Park from Seattle through Van /Ferry

description.text: Olympic National Park is a fantastic day trip from Seattle, offering stunning mountain views, lush rainforest trails, and a wild coastline. This tour will be tailored to highlight the best on the route, considering crowd avoidance, group preference, and weather conditions. You'll travel by ferry to Bainbridge Island, take an animal safari in Sequim, hike to a waterfall, see the blue glacial waters at Crescent Lake, and visit Olympic National Park.

highlights: Visit Olympic National Park for dense rainforests, a rugged coastline, and alpine peaks
Savor the views at Lake Crescent Lake
See llamas, zebras, Tibetan yaks, and more at the Olympic Game Farm
